name: Hyperscale SSD Framework CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pages: write
  id-token: write

env:
  SITE_DIR: site

jobs:
  test:
    name: Run tests on ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]

    outputs:
      test_outcome: ${{ steps.run_behave_tests.outputs.test_outcome }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: 3.11

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          if [[ "${{ runner.os }}" == "Linux" ]]; then
            sudo apt-get update
            sudo apt-get install -y jq
          else
            choco install jq -y || true
          fi

      - name: Run Behave Tests
        id: run_behave_tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail || true
          OS_NAME=${{ matrix.os }}
          BUILD_NUMBER=${{ github.run_number }}
          REPORT_DIR="reports/$BUILD_NUMBER/$OS_NAME"
          mkdir -p "$REPORT_DIR"

          echo ">>> Running behave on $OS_NAME, build $BUILD_NUMBER"
          behave --tags=@adv --exclude "features/manual_tests" \
            --format behave_html_pretty_formatter:PrettyHTMLFormatter \
            -o "$REPORT_DIR/validation_report.html" --no-capture | tee /tmp/behave_output.txt || true
          TEST_EXIT_CODE=${PIPESTATUS[0]:-0} || true

          if [ "$TEST_EXIT_CODE" -ne 0 ]; then
            if grep -q "failed" /tmp/behave_output.txt 2>/dev/null; then
              RESULT=UNSTABLE
            else
              RESULT=FAIL
            fi
          else
            RESULT=PASS
          fi

          echo "Detected result: $RESULT"
          echo "test_outcome=$RESULT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$RESULT" > "$REPORT_DIR/status.txt"
          echo "$(TZ='America/Los_Angeles' date)" > "$REPORT_DIR/timestamp.txt"

          # Extract scenario counts (defensive)
          SUMMARY_LINE=$(grep -E 'scenarios?(\.|:)' /tmp/behave_output.txt | tail -n 1 || true)
          echo "Behave summary line: '$SUMMARY_LINE'"

          PASSED_COUNT=$(echo "$SUMMARY_LINE" | sed -E 's/.*([0-9]+) scenarios? passed.*/\1/' 2>/dev/null | grep -o '^[0-9]\+$' || echo 0)
          FAILED_COUNT=$(echo "$SUMMARY_LINE" | sed -E 's/.*, ([0-9]+) failed.*/\1/' 2>/dev/null | grep -o '^[0-9]\+$' || echo 0)
          # If behave printed "0 failed" pattern different, try fallback: parse numbers from string
          if ! echo "$PASSED_COUNT" | grep -q '^[0-9]\+$'; then
            PASSED_COUNT=0
          fi
          if ! echo "$FAILED_COUNT" | grep -q '^[0-9]\+$'; then
            FAILED_COUNT=0
          fi

          BROKEN_COUNT=$([ "$RESULT" = "UNSTABLE" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)

          # write summary.json (force numeric types)
          jq -n --argjson p "$PASSED_COUNT" --argjson f "$FAILED_COUNT" --argjson b "$BROKEN_COUNT" \
            '{statistic: {passed: $p, failed: $f, broken: $b}}' > "$REPORT_DIR/summary.json"

          echo "Wrote $REPORT_DIR/summary.json:"
          cat "$REPORT_DIR/summary.json"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: reports/${{ github.run_number }}/${{ matrix.os }}/

  report:
    name: Generate Reports & Deploy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: test

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install JQ
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Get workflow filename
        id: get_workflow_name
        run: echo "WORKFLOW_FILE=$(basename .github/workflows/*.yml)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Download previous history artifact (if any)
        uses: dawidd6/action-download-artifact@v6
        with:
          workflow: ${{ env.WORKFLOW_FILE }}
          branch: main
          name: history
          path: previous-site
          if_no_artifact_found: ignore

      - name: Restore full history (robust)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail || true
          SITE_DIR="${{ env.SITE_DIR }}"
          mkdir -p "$SITE_DIR"
          if [ -d "previous-site" ]; then
            echo "♻️ previous-site contents:"
            find previous-site -maxdepth 2 -printf "  %p\n" || true

            # Move numeric build dirs into site root explicitly
            for D in previous-site/*; do
              [ -e "$D" ] || continue
              BASE=$(basename "$D")
              if [[ "$BASE" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
                echo "Merging previous build folder: $BASE"
                mkdir -p "$SITE_DIR/$BASE"
                rsync -a "$D/" "$SITE_DIR/$BASE/" || true
              else
                # non-numeric top-level (e.g. latest or other files) -> merge into site/
                echo "Merging non-build folder: $BASE"
                rsync -a "$D/" "$SITE_DIR/" || true
              fi
            done

            echo "After restore, site top-level folders:"
            find "$SITE_DIR" -maxdepth 2 -printf "  %p\n" || true
          else
            echo "No previous-site artifact found."
          fi

      - name: Download Test Results
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: reports

      - name: Generate Reports Per OS (robust copy + diagnostics)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail || true
          SITE_DIR="site"
          BUILD_NUMBER=${{ github.run_number }}
          mkdir -p "$SITE_DIR/latest"

          for OS in ubuntu-latest windows-latest; do
            REPORT_DIR_BUILD="$SITE_DIR/$BUILD_NUMBER/$OS"
            REPORT_DIR_LATEST="$SITE_DIR/latest/$OS"
            mkdir -p "$REPORT_DIR_BUILD" "$REPORT_DIR_LATEST"

            echo "----- Processing artifacts for $OS into $REPORT_DIR_BUILD and $REPORT_DIR_LATEST"

            if compgen -G "reports/build-$OS/*" > /dev/null; then
              echo "Copying reports/build-$OS/* -> $REPORT_DIR_BUILD/"
              cp -R reports/build-$OS/* "$REPORT_DIR_BUILD/" || true
            else
              echo "WARNING: no artifacts found at reports/build-$OS/ (maybe build artifact failed to upload)"
            fi

            # If validation_report.html exists, copy it as index.html for Pages
            if [ -f "$REPORT_DIR_BUILD/validation_report.html" ]; then
              echo "Copying validation_report.html -> latest index.html"
              cp "$REPORT_DIR_BUILD/validation_report.html" "$REPORT_DIR_LATEST/index.html"
            else
              echo "No validation_report.html in $REPORT_DIR_BUILD (will not create latest index.html from it)"
            fi

            # Ensure summary.json exists -- if not, try to find a summary.json anywhere inside the build dir
            if [ -f "$REPORT_DIR_BUILD/summary.json" ]; then
              cp "$REPORT_DIR_BUILD/summary.json" "$REPORT_DIR_LATEST/summary.json"
            else
              echo "summary.json not found at $REPORT_DIR_BUILD/summary.json. Searching..."
              FOUND=$(find "$REPORT_DIR_BUILD" -type f -iname 'summary.json' -print -quit || true)
              if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then
                echo "Found summary.json at $FOUND - copying to latest"
                cp "$FOUND" "$REPORT_DIR_LATEST/summary.json"
                cp "$FOUND" "$REPORT_DIR_BUILD/summary.json"
              else
                echo "WARNING: summary.json missing for build $BUILD_NUMBER $OS"
                # create a default summary.json so chart code sees numeric zeros rather than failing
                jq -n '{statistic:{passed:0,failed:0,broken:0}}' > "$REPORT_DIR_BUILD/summary.json"
                cp "$REPORT_DIR_BUILD/summary.json" "$REPORT_DIR_LATEST/summary.json"
              fi
            fi

            # Copy everything to latest (again) to ensure pages pickup
            cp -R "$REPORT_DIR_BUILD/"* "$REPORT_DIR_LATEST/" || true

            REPO_NAME="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY##*/}"
            echo "{\"name\":\"$OS\",\"type\":\"GitHub Actions\",\"url\":\"${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\",\"reportUrl\":\"https://${GITHUB_REPOSITORY_OWNER}.github.io/${REPO_NAME}/latest/$OS/\",\"buildOrder\":\"${BUILD_NUMBER}\",\"buildName\":\"Build ${BUILD_NUMBER} ($OS)\",\"buildUrl\":\"${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"}" > "$REPORT_DIR_LATEST/executor.json"

            date -u > "$REPORT_DIR_BUILD/build-info.txt"
            date -u > "$REPORT_DIR_LATEST/build-info.txt"
          done

      - name: Rebuild index.html with Trend Charts (with diagnostics)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail || true
          SITE_DIR="site"
          CURRENT_LA_TIME=$(TZ='America/Los_Angeles' date)
          mkdir -p "$SITE_DIR"
          echo "<html><head><title>Reports History</title>
          <script src='https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js'></script>
          <style>
          body{font-family:sans-serif;margin:20px;}
          ul{list-style:none;padding:0;}
          li{margin:6px 0;}
          a{text-decoration:none;color:#0366d6;}
          a:hover{text-decoration:underline;}
          #chart-container {max-width:800px;max-height:400px;margin:0;}
          </style></head><body>
          <h1>🤖 Hyperscale SSD Framework CI/CD Build History</h1>
          <h2>🧩 Latest Reports</h2><hr><ul>" > "$SITE_DIR/index.html"

          for OS in ubuntu-latest windows-latest; do
            if [ -d "$SITE_DIR/latest/$OS" ]; then
              TS_UTC=$(cat "$SITE_DIR/latest/$OS/build-info.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
              TS_DISPLAY=$(TZ='America/Los_Angeles' date -d "$TS_UTC" '+%a %b %d %H:%M:%S PDT %Y' 2>/dev/null || echo "$TS_UTC")
              echo "<li><strong><a href='latest/$OS/'>Latest Report ($OS)</a></strong> - Last run: $TS_DISPLAY</li>" >> "$SITE_DIR/index.html"
            else
              echo "<li><strong>$OS:</strong> (No report found)</li>" >> "$SITE_DIR/index.html"
            fi
          done
          echo "</ul><hr><h2>📊 Report History & Trends (Times in PDT)</h2><ul>" >> "$SITE_DIR/index.html"

          # list all numeric build dirs (after restore)
          BUILDS=$(find "$SITE_DIR" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -printf "%f\n" | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | sort -nr || true)
          echo "Detected build folders: $BUILDS" 1>&2

          CHART_BUILDS=$(echo "$BUILDS" | sort -n)
          LABELS=""
          PASS_COUNTS=""
          FAIL_COUNTS=""
          UNSTABLE_COUNTS=""

          for BUILD in $CHART_BUILDS; do
            echo "Processing build $BUILD" 1>&2
            TS_UTC=$(cat "$SITE_DIR/$BUILD/ubuntu-latest/build-info.txt" 2>/dev/null || cat "$SITE_DIR/$BUILD/windows-latest/build-info.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
            TS_DISPLAY=$(TZ='America/Los_Angeles' date -d "$TS_UTC" '+%a %b %d %H:%M:%S PDT %Y' 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A")
            echo "<li><strong>Build #${BUILD}</strong> (Run: $TS_DISPLAY) - <a href='${BUILD}/ubuntu-latest/'>Ubuntu</a> / <a href='${BUILD}/windows-latest/'>Windows</a></li>" >> "$SITE_DIR/index.html"

            TOTAL_PASS=0
            TOTAL_FAIL=0
            TOTAL_UNSTABLE=0

            for OS in ubuntu-latest windows-latest; do
              SUMMARY_FILE="$SITE_DIR/$BUILD/$OS/summary.json"
              if [ -f "$SUMMARY_FILE" ]; then
                echo "Reading $SUMMARY_FILE" 1>&2
                PASS_COUNT=$(jq -r '.statistic.passed // 0 | tonumber' "$SUMMARY_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
                FAIL_COUNT=$(jq -r '.statistic.failed // 0 | tonumber' "$SUMMARY_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
                BROKEN_COUNT=$(jq -r '.statistic.broken // 0 | tonumber' "$SUMMARY_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
                echo " -> $OS: pass=$PASS_COUNT fail=$FAIL_COUNT broken=$BROKEN_COUNT" 1>&2
                TOTAL_PASS=$((TOTAL_PASS + PASS_COUNT))
                TOTAL_FAIL=$((TOTAL_FAIL + FAIL_COUNT))
                TOTAL_UNSTABLE=$((TOTAL_UNSTABLE + BROKEN_COUNT))
              else
                echo "WARNING: missing $SUMMARY_FILE" 1>&2
              fi
            done

            LABELS="$LABELS'$BUILD',"
            PASS_COUNTS="$PASS_COUNTS$TOTAL_PASS,"
            FAIL_COUNTS="$FAIL_COUNTS$TOTAL_FAIL,"
            UNSTABLE_COUNTS="$UNSTABLE_COUNTS$TOTAL_UNSTABLE,"
          done

          echo "</ul>" >> "$SITE_DIR/index.html"

          echo "<div id='chart-container'><canvas id='trendChart'></canvas></div>
          <script>
          const ctx = document.getElementById('trendChart').getContext('2d');
          new Chart(ctx, {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
              labels: [${LABELS%,}],
              datasets: [
                {label: 'PASS', data: [${PASS_COUNTS%,}], borderColor: 'green', fill: false},
                {label: 'FAIL', data: [${FAIL_COUNTS%,}], borderColor: 'red', fill: false},
                {label: 'UNSTABLE', data: [${UNSTABLE_COUNTS%,}], borderColor: 'orange', fill: false}
              ]
            },
            options: {
              responsive: true,
              maintainAspectRatio: false,
              plugins: { legend: { position: 'top' } },
              scales: {
                y: { beginAtZero: true, stepSize: 1, min: 0, title: { display: true, text: 'Total Number of Tests' } },
                x: { title: { display: true, text: 'Build Number' } }
              }
            }
          });
          </script><hr><p><em>Generated automatically on $CURRENT_LA_TIME</em></p></body></html>" >> "$SITE_DIR/index.html"

      - name: Upload Pages Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: ${{ env.SITE_DIR }}

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

      - name: Upload History Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: history
          path: ${{ env.SITE_DIR }}
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Add Workflow Summary (Badges)
        run: |
          PAGE_URL=${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
          BASE_URL="${PAGE_URL%/}"
          TEST_STATUS=${{ needs.test.outputs.test_outcome }}

          if [[ "$TEST_STATUS" == "FAIL" ]]; then
            STATUS_ICON="❌"
            STATUS_TEXT="Failed (setup/config error)"
          elif [[ "$TEST_STATUS" == "UNSTABLE" ]]; then
            STATUS_ICON="⚠️"
            STATUS_TEXT="Unstable (some tests failed)"
          else
            STATUS_ICON="✅"
            STATUS_TEXT="All tests passed"
          fi

          echo "### 🤖 Hyperscale SSD Framework CI/CD" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "[![Ubuntu Latest Report](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ubuntu-Latest_Build-blue)](${BASE_URL}/latest/ubuntu-latest/index.html)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "[![Windows Latest Report](https://img.shields.io/badge/Windows-Latest_Build-blue)](${BASE_URL}/latest/windows-latest/index.html)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "[![Report History](https://img.shields.io/badge/All-Builds-green)](${BASE_URL}/)" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "Build #${{ github.run_number }} | Status: $STATUS_ICON $STATUS_TEXT" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
